items.title: Effect of Different Ligands on ΔE and Colour (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Effect of Different Ligands on ΔE and Colour: a main subheading of 18.6.1 Colour Formation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 27-27.

blocks.text: Ligand ki type splitting ΔE ke magnitude (miqdar) par asar karti hai. NH₃ aur CN⁻ jaise ligands zyada splitting karte hain (energy gap ΔE barhta hai), jab ke Cl⁻ aur I⁻ jaise ligands ke saath ΔE chhota hota hai. Zyada ΔE ka matlab hai ke zyada frequency (chhoti wavelength) wali, violet ya blue, light absorb hogi; is ke muqable mein yellow light reflect ho kar compound peela dikhta hai. Kuch complexes kam energy wali (red/orange) light absorb karte hain aur complementary scheme ke mutabiq blue ya green dikhte hain. Ligands ko d-orbital splitting ki salahiyat ke mutabiq (zyada ΔE se kam ΔE) is order (tarteeb) mein rakha jata hai:

blocks.text_alt: CN⁻ > en > NH₃ > H₂O > OH⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻

blocks.prompt: a) Ligands ki presence (maujoodgi) complex ion mein d-orbitals ki degeneracy par kaise asar karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Ligands ka electric field paanch degenerate d orbitals ko alag alag energy ke do non-degenerate sets mein baant deta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Octahedral aur tetrahedral complexes ki d-orbital splitting mein basic farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein paanch d orbitals do sets mein bat jate hain, lekin order ulta hai:

blocks.prompt: c) Absorb hone wali light ki energy (ΔE) aur nazar aane wale rang ka relation (talluq) Planck's equation (ΔE = hν = hc/λ) se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Zyada ΔE ka matlab zyada frequency aur chhoti wavelength wali light absorb hoti hai; nazar aane wala rang absorb hone wali light ka complementary rang hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Cl⁻ wala complex red/orange light absorb karta hai. Yeh kis rang ka dikhega?
blocks.explanation: Blue se green, jo orange aur red ke complementary rang hain.

blocks.prompt: e) Transition metal compounds ke rang ke zimmedar d-d transitions samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Split hue d orbitals mein neeche wale set ka electron ΔE ke barabar energy wala photon absorb kar ke upar wale set mein jata hai; woh rang white light se nikal jata hai aur baqi rang nazar aata hai.

items: Nazar aane wala rang = absorb hone wali light ka complementary rang.
Splitting: CN⁻ > en > NH₃ > H₂O > OH⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻.
